title: Console Onboarding: Compact Activation Tiles & Keyboard-first Tour
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and deliver a compact, keyboard-first onboarding tour for the Redwood Console that pairs an initial checklist of activation tiles with contextual empty-state illustrations and guided microtips. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for new users from sign-up -> first API call by 30% and improve checklist completion rate to 75% within the first session. Deliverables: 1) Figma components (compact tiles, 3 empty-state illustrations, tip popover variants), 2) annotated redlines for engineering (responsive rules, keyboard focus states, motion spec), 3) microcopy library for each tile and tooltip, 4) two A/B visual variants (illustration-led vs. icon-led) for experimental rollout, 5) annotated screenshots for release notes and docs. Constraints: must fit in existing Console header real-estate, support both short and long org names, work at 320px min width, meet contrast AA and keyboard-only navigation, and avoid using illustrations that imply specific user data. Work to coordinate with ENG for focus management and with PM for success metrics tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Compact activation tile component exported to Figma with responsive variants and documented tokens
Keyboard navigation walkthrough documented: tab order, focus ring, skip link behaviour
Three empty-state illustration variants available as SVG with accessible alt text and color tokens
Microcopy file approved by PM and localized-ready (strings separated in CSV)
Engineering has a redline doc with implementation checklist and an associated GitHub PR for integration
